name: Death Gaze
text:
Aspect death

Activate 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

---

Effect Your stare causes a creature's flesh to rot and wither away. Target a creature you can see within 30 feet. Your stare deals 1d6 void damage to the creature for every 2 levels the relic has (minimum 1d6; basic Fortitude save save). An undead creature or other creature with void healing targeted this way is instead healed 1d6 healing HP per level of the relic and is temporarily immune to this effect for 10 minutes.
